title: First Day
overview: "On his first day at work in a large factory,  Milos sets out to prove himself, only to  discover a workplace frozen in inertia. No  one seems to know what the factory  produces, what their role is, or who is in  charge. To find his purpose Milos embarks  on a journey that leads him deeper and  deeper down the factory, encountering men  who are all doing the same thing: nothing."
